doc: The game's balance table: experience and levels, the flame's altars and water sources, base fog resistance, durability, sockets and perk unlock costs. The game reads it once at start.

xpPerLevel.doc: The experience levels 1 to 5 need (later levels follow xpCurve). Exactly 5 values, edited one at a time (xpPerLevel[i]).

xpCurve.doc: The experience a level from 6 needs: base = min(start, end) + |end - start| * level / levelMax; need = round(base * seed * 1.5 + fromKnowledge).

start.doc: One end of the curve's base range (base = min(start, end) + |end - start| * level / levelMax).

end.doc: The other end of the curve's base range.

levelMax.doc: The level at which the base has moved the whole way from one end of the range to the other.

seed.doc: The factor the base is multiplied by (with 1.5) to give the experience a level needs.

fromKnowledge.doc: Experience added to every level's need after the factor.

flameLevelMax.doc: The highest flame level. Read-only in this version: the per-flame-level lists are exactly flameLevelMax + 1 long.

altarsPerFlameLevel.doc: Flame altars allowed at each flame level, one value per level from 0 to flameLevelMax (the game's code stops at 16). Edited one level at a time (altarsPerFlameLevel[i]).

waterSourcesPerFlameLevel.doc: Water sources allowed at each flame level, one value per level from 0 to flameLevelMax. Edited one level at a time.

buildzoneSizesPerAltarLevel.doc: The size of an altar's build zone at each altar level, in metres.

x.doc: The build zone's size along x, in metres.

y.doc: The build zone's size along y (height), in metres.

z.doc: The build zone's size along z, in metres.

base.doc: A player's shroud time before any flame level.

perFlameLevel.doc: The shroud time each flame level adds.

durability.doc: An item's maximum durability: (start + growth * (level - 1)) * rarityDurability[rarity]. Each copy computes it when it is loaded.

start.doc: The maximum durability of a level 1 item, before the rarity factor.

growth.doc: The maximum durability each item level above 1 adds, before the rarity factor.

rarityDurability.doc: The durability factor of each rarity.

common.doc: The durability factor of common items.

uncommon.doc: The durability factor of uncommon items.

rare.doc: The durability factor of rare items.

epic.doc: The durability factor of epic items.

legendary.doc: The durability factor of legendary items.

socketChance.doc: The chance a new weapon of each rarity gets a gem socket (0 to 1).

common.doc: The chance a new common weapon gets a gem socket.

uncommon.doc: The chance a new uncommon weapon gets a gem socket.

rare.doc: The chance a new rare weapon gets a gem socket.

epic.doc: The chance a new epic weapon gets a gem socket.

legendary.doc: The chance a new legendary weapon gets a gem socket.

seed.doc: The base cost of a perk unlock, before the creep and the kind's factor.

creep.doc: How much the cost grows with each unlock step, as a factor of the base.

weapons.doc: The cost factor of weapon and shield perks.

armor.doc: The cost factor of armour perks.

rings.doc: The cost factor of ring perks.

advanced.doc: The numerator of an advanced perk's cost.

advancedFrom.doc: The perk level (0 to 5) from which the advanced cost applies.

gear.doc: The constants of the power and armour formulas (items.power, items.armor). Read-only in this version: Kiln's solver follows them.

seed.doc: The base of the damage power formula: base power = int(seed * creep * level + seed).

creep.doc: The share of seed the base power grows by with each level.

armorOffset.doc: The armour formula's offset: armour = round((armorGradient * level + armorOffset) * share).

armorGradient.doc: The armour each level adds in the armour formula, before the item's share.
